people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water: that he would be revealed to Israel.”
translations.bsb: I myself did not know Him, but the reason I came baptizing with water was that He might be revealed to Israel.”
translations.kjv: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water.
translations.asv: And I knew him not; but that he should be made manifest to Israel, for this cause came I baptizing in water.
